Strategy: Shift the sweet band downward to residuals between twenty-five and forty while keeping the mid penalty, testing whether slightly tighter leftovers work better. This steers bins toward reusable middle residuals and away from awkward small gaps, but the shifted band may match fewer real item sizes.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 25 and r - item <= 40 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
